verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented way for an operator to restrict which apps, surfaces, or accounts Sai may touch. The approval prompts before sensitive actions (sending, paying, deleting) are an adjacent control, not an enforced scope limit. Running in its own cloud VM is isolation, not a configurable allowlist. The docs instead stress that Sai works across the entire operating system: 'If you can click it, Sai can.'
